'''David Errigo Jr.''' is a voice actor for the English-language dub of {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is currently affiliated with SBV Talent Agency.

==Biography==
As an adult, Errigo became a voice actor and got minor roles in 2013 and 2014. Starting in 2015, he got more significant roles in TV shows and video games. Errigo joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|XY}} and voiced, among others, [[Nihei]], one of the older brothers of {{Ash}}'s friend [[Sanpei]]. Later in {{DetPikMov}}, he would voice {{p|Cubone}}.
